comparison.objective: PR-1882 joins articulated chain ends with a connecting link and side-entry keeper; the candidate sets a gripper opening limit.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1882 tests multi-hole alignment and lateral keeper insertion into a loose chain assembly, not coupled screw-and-nut counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1882 requires both ends seated, keeper retained, joint cradled, chain guided, and hands released; the candidate requires a locked angle surviving three cycles.
comparison.reason: Although both include retention, chain-link assembly does not test preserving a calibrated setting against jam-nut tightening reaction.
